messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Elevated RPM and queue depth observed for model-family 'cobalt13b' in us-west-2. Error rate stable but worker queue growing. Auto-scaling not keeping up.

maya: seeing it. queues +30% in the last 2m. routing heatmap shows 60% of requests for cobalt13b single-tenant customers.

chris: I'm paged and looking. Quick ask: do we size down cobalt or route to fallback? Can we temporarily lower cobalt13b RPM/TMP?

maya: yes let's sculpt. Priorities: 1) keep overall API latency < 1.2s 2) minimize 429s for PLG customers 3) protect enterprise reserved capacity.

priya: FYI support: two customers reported slow responses, no errors yet. CS on standby.

maya: plan: lower cobalt13b RPM by 40% and ramp up fallback 'orion13b-lite' RPM by 20%. disable function-calling on cobalt for now (adds CPU).

chris: executing now. command:
```
rictl quota update --model cobalt13b --rpm 800 --tpm 16000 --note "emergency sculpt 4219801234"
rictl quota update --model orion13b-lite --rpm 600 --tpm 12000 --note "spillover absorb"
rictl feature toggle --model cobalt13b --feature funcall --state off --note "temp disable during load"
```

maya: :white_check_mark: cobalt quota change applied (new rpm 800). orion update applied. funcall disabled.

incident-bot: Audit: quota-change by chris at 4219801302. summary: cobalt13b rpm 2000->800, orion13b-lite rpm 500->600, funcall off.

jen (support): Noted. I'll patch the customer-facing ticket template. Two customers (cust-834, cust-912) hit latency >2s; put them on high touch.

priya: any observed increase in 429s? we should watch rate-limit dashboards.

chris: initial metrics: global 429s +0.2% (expected), median p50 latency improved 200ms, queue depth declined. CPU on cobalt pods down 45%.

maya: good. next: keep these changes for 10m then evaluate. If stable, revert funcall disable but keep sculpted RPM until auto-scaler tuned.

chris: adding temporary runbook note:
```
- timestamp: 4219801302
- action: per-model rpm/tpm sculpt
- rollback: rictl quota update --model cobalt13b --rpm 2000 --tpm 40000
- contacts: priya, jen
```

maya: handing off to chris for monitoring. I'll escalate to infra if autoscaler needs patch. chris, you're owner for next 30m.

chris: onit. will post updates every 5m or on notable changes.

incident-bot: :information_source: Handoff recorded: owner=chris, until=4219803189 (30m).
